title: The comment check catches history phrases and lets dated or rounding why-comments pass
why: lint/check_comment_narration.py now runs in every repo that pins claude-settings (PR #998). Its patterns miss history phrases and flag real why-comments, so sessions in other repos will hit false alarms.
note: Misses: "Previously this returned None", "Changed from the old behaviour", "Added after review by billing". False alarms: "round 2 decimals so the total matches the invoice", "Tax rule effective 2024-07-01". Recorded as comment-narration-limits in docs/debts/notes.md (lane comment-lint-every-repo). No owner question: the rule building-comments-say-why already says what to flag, and a pattern change can be undone. Red first: each phrase above as a fixture, misses red and false alarms green. Port: yes, the check is shared. Ready after PR #998 merges. Lane session_013NEJKzMnPtahmg9vLibwjv, started by the coordinator Nov 3 16:57 CST.
